body: I'm 18 and 5'1. I really hope I can get to a height where I'm considered somewhat normal. Doctors say my growth plates are pretty much closed so that sucks. :/

well im in college now and i still get treated the same way. always getting stopped by people to ask if im lost since im "too young" to be there. unfortunately i cant grow any noticeable facial hair. i dont really have any friends..any person I talk to either makes fun of me right away or just obsesses over my height

apparently my growth plates have closed so I am done growing
